# Pharmaceutical Technology

> > Pharmaceutical Technology delivers comprehensive coverage of pharmaceutical industry news, market analysis, clinical trials, regulatory developments, and emerging technologies including AI, ADCs, and cell therapy manufacturing.

The site provides in-depth reporting on major pharmaceutical companies (Roche, Pfizer, GSK, Bayer), regulatory agencies (FDA, MHRA), market forecasts from GlobalData, and strategic developments across global markets including the United States, United Kingdom, Europe, and Japan. Coverage spans drug development, licensing agreements, M&A activity, and technological innovations transforming the pharmaceutical landscape.

## Key Topics

- FDA approvals and regulatory developments
- GlobalData market forecasts and analysis
- Artificial intelligence in healthcare and drug development
- Mergers and acquisitions (M&A)
- Clinical trials and real-world evidence (RWE)
- Antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs)
- Cell and gene therapy (CGT) manufacturing
- Licensing agreements and partnerships
- Oncology and cancer therapeutics
- Orphan drug designations
- Pipeline products and treatment landscapes
- Medical imaging technologies
- Biosimilars and branded medicines
- 7MM markets (seven major markets)
- MHRA and UK pharmaceutical regulation

- [JPM26: Regeneron will not overpay in M&A deals amid lead asset patent expiries](https://www.pharmaceutical-technology.com/news/jpm26-regeneron-will-not-overpay-in-ma-deals-amid-lead-asset-patent-expiries): Regeneron prioritizes R&D over M&A despite Eylea patent expiries
- [General Proximity and Daiichi Sankyo collaborate on oncology](https://www.pharmaceutical-technology.com/news/general-proximity-daiichi-sankyo-oncology): Daiichi Sankyo partners with General Proximity on OmniTAC platform
- [Crescent and Kelun-Biotech swap cancer asset rights in double deal](https://www.pharmaceutical-technology.com/news/crescent-and-kelun-biotech-swap-cancer-asset-rights-in-double-deal): Crescent and Kelun-Biotech exchange oncology asset regional rights
- [JPM26: Madrigal seeks early dominance in MASH through strategic acquisitions](https://www.pharmaceutical-technology.com/analyst-comment/jpm26-madrigal-seeks-early-dominance-in-mash-through-strategic-acquisitions): Madrigal pursues MASH market leadership via combination therapy strategy

- [Opna Bio's OPN-2853 secures FDA's orphan drug status for myelofibrosis](https://www.pharmaceutical-technology.com/news/opna-bios-opn2853-fdas-status): FDA grants Opna Bio orphan drug status for OPN-2853 in myelofibrosis

- [Apotex, Grünenthal sign deal for Nebido Canadian distribution](https://www.pharmaceutical-technology.com/news/apotex-grunenthal-nebido-canadian-distribution): Apotex gains exclusive Canadian rights to Grünenthal's Nebido testosterone
